topics.headline: Iran launches ballistic missiles at U.S. forces in the Middle East
topics.snippet: U.S. Central Command said Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps forces launched multiple ballistic missiles from Iran at 5:45 p.m. ET on July 28 in an attempted surprise attack on U.S. forces based in the…
topics.text:
iran launches ballistic missiles at u.s. forces in the middle east
u.s. central command said islamic revolutionary guard corps forces launched multiple ballistic missiles from iran at 5:45 p.m. et on july 28 in an attempted surprise attack on u.s. forces based in the middle east. centcom said all of the missiles were intercepted and that u.s. forces remain at a high state of readiness.

topics.headline: Trump hosts Netanyahu and Zelensky as Iran and Ukraine wars escalate
topics.snippet: President Donald Trump met separately with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky at the White House on July 28, with both leaders also attending Senator…
topics.text:
trump hosts netanyahu and zelensky as iran and ukraine wars escalate
president donald trump met separately with israeli prime minister benjamin netanyahu and ukrainian president volodymyr zelensky at the white house on july 28, with both leaders also attending senator lindsey graham's funeral. netanyahu, who is subject to an international criminal court arrest warrant, has visited the united states more frequently than any other head of state over the past two years, with past visits often preceding requests for weapons or aid. graham, regarded as one of the republican party's strongest advocates for ukraine, had recently returned from a trip to kyiv before his death. over the preceding weekend, ukraine confirmed it deliberately struck iranian vessels, drawing the two conflicts closer together.

topics.headline: Trump appears to doze off and veer from script at Lindsey Graham's funeral
topics.snippet: During Senator Lindsey Graham's funeral, Trump appeared to struggle to stay awake, with observers reporting he seemed asleep for multiple minutes at a time and appeared visibly uncomfortable during a…
topics.text:
trump appears to doze off and veer from script at lindsey graham's funeral
during senator lindsey graham's funeral, trump appeared to struggle to stay awake, with observers reporting he seemed asleep for multiple minutes at a time and appeared visibly uncomfortable during a eulogy delivered by graham's niece. trump also departed from his prepared remarks, which said that virtually everyone in washington liked graham, adding that not everyone did. he separately said graham put his heart into his work "until it literally gave out." trump, 80, is the oldest president in american history.

topics.headline: Trump privately dwells on his own mortality after Graham's death
topics.snippet: According to the Washington Post, Trump has increasingly discussed his own mortality behind the scenes following Lindsey Graham's sudden death. He has raised concerns that Graham's heavy travel schedu…
topics.text:
trump privately dwells on his own mortality after graham's death
according to the washington post, trump has increasingly discussed his own mortality behind the scenes following lindsey graham's sudden death. he has raised concerns that graham's heavy travel schedule may have contributed to his deteriorating health and has looked into graham's family history for genetic factors. trump is the oldest sitting president in u.s. history at 80 and has two years remaining in his term.

topics.headline: Beshear tells McConnell to explain his absence or resign
topics.snippet: Kentucky Governor Andy Beshear sent a follow-up letter to Senator Mitch McConnell demanding an explanation of his health issues and continued absence from the Senate, or his resignation. In the letter…
topics.text:
beshear tells mcconnell to explain his absence or resign
kentucky governor andy beshear sent a follow-up letter to senator mitch mcconnell demanding an explanation of his health issues and continued absence from the senate, or his resignation. in the letter, obtained by cnn, beshear wrote that he was addressing mcconnell on the assumption he is capable of reading and responding and is not incapacitated in consciousness or cognition. the daily beast reported the letter was also sent to senate republican leader john thune. a governor has no power to force a senator to resign.

topics.headline: FIFA plan would put Kushner-backed company in charge of the World Cup
topics.snippet: FIFA President Gianni Infantino announced a plan to create a $20 billion private company, backed by the Kushner family alongside other private investors, to run the World Cup. The proposal was first r…
topics.text:
fifa plan would put kushner-backed company in charge of the world cup
fifa president gianni infantino announced a plan to create a $20 billion private company, backed by the kushner family alongside other private investors, to run the world cup. the proposal was first reported by the financial times. uefa objected, saying the tournament is "not fifa's to sell" and that none of the governing bodies own football.

topics.headline: ICE used forced medical treatment on a detainee on hunger strike
topics.snippet: The Guardian reviewed a newly released ICE document showing the agency subjected at least one immigration detainee on a hunger strike to forcible medical treatment, including forced feeding, hydration…
topics.text:
ice used forced medical treatment on a detainee on hunger strike
the guardian reviewed a newly released ice document showing the agency subjected at least one immigration detainee on a hunger strike to forcible medical treatment, including forced feeding, hydration, forced urinary catheterization or involuntary blood draws. the unnamed detainee began the hunger strike between october and december of last year. international human rights groups have described such treatment as tantamount to torture, and it can carry significant medical complications.

topics.headline: ICE escalates arrests of visa overstays at U.S. airports
topics.snippet: According to the New York Times, ICE is increasing stops and arrests at airports targeting travelers with expired visas, working with TSA in a form of cooperation that previously did not exist. The ag…
topics.text:
ice escalates arrests of visa overstays at u.s. airports
according to the new york times, ice is increasing stops and arrests at airports targeting travelers with expired visas, working with tsa in a form of cooperation that previously did not exist. the agency has prioritized these stops on at least a dozen occasions. many of those affected are in legal limbo, awaiting green cards or visa extensions, and had rarely been detained at airports in the past.

topics.headline: More than 12,000 arrested using child migrant agency data
topics.snippet: A Reuters investigation found that more than 12,000 people were arrested after the U.S. agency responsible for unaccompanied child migrants shared leads with ICE. The data had been collected in the co…
topics.text:
more than 12,000 arrested using child migrant agency data
a reuters investigation found that more than 12,000 people were arrested after the u.s. agency responsible for unaccompanied child migrants shared leads with ice. the data had been collected in the course of placing children with sponsors.

topics.headline: Gaza's advancing yellow line forces new displacement
topics.snippet: Residents of Gaza say the expansion of the so-called yellow line is compelling families to relocate again. The shifting boundary has driven a new round of displacement for people who had already moved…
topics.text:
gaza's advancing yellow line forces new displacement
residents of gaza say the expansion of the so-called yellow line is compelling families to relocate again. the shifting boundary has driven a new round of displacement for people who had already moved during the conflict.

topics.headline: Gulf states back Omani plan for voluntary Iranian fees in Hormuz
topics.snippet: Gulf states have endorsed an Omani proposal for voluntary Iranian fees on shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, a source told Reuters. Roughly one in five barrels of the world's oil consumption norma…
topics.text:
gulf states back omani plan for voluntary iranian fees in hormuz
gulf states have endorsed an omani proposal for voluntary iranian fees on shipping through the strait of hormuz, a source told reuters. roughly one in five barrels of the world's oil consumption normally passes through the strait.

topics.headline: Texas police searched 83,000 Flock cameras to find a woman suspected of self-administering an abortion
topics.snippet: According to 404 Media, Texas authorities searched 83,000 Flock license plate reader cameras nationwide in April 2025 while looking for a woman a county sheriff said had self-administered an abortion,…
topics.text:
texas police searched 83,000 flock cameras to find a woman suspected of self-administering an abortion
according to 404 media, texas authorities searched 83,000 flock license plate reader cameras nationwide in april 2025 while looking for a woman a county sheriff said had self-administered an abortion, citing family concerns for her safety. the searches extended into states where abortion remains legal, including washington and illinois. the case did not result in charges, but experts warn it shows police in states where abortion is banned can search camera networks in states where it is not.

topics.headline: Federal government approves first data center on BLM public land
topics.snippet: The Bureau of Land Management approved a data center in Boulder City, Nevada, by allowing a developer to convert a 2023 permit for solar and battery storage, on the reasoning that the two uses are "su…
topics.text:
federal government approves first data center on blm public land
the bureau of land management approved a data center in boulder city, nevada, by allowing a developer to convert a 2023 permit for solar and battery storage, on the reasoning that the two uses are "substantially the same." no new environmental review and no public comment period were required, and the nearby city learned of the decision afterward. it is the first data center approved on blm-managed land. a similar pattern has appeared in utah, where a military land designation removed a proposed data center decision from county control, and the pentagon is leasing military land to private data center developers in texas and utah. a petition asks interior to rescind the approval, and a bill to ban data centers on federal land has been introduced.

topics.headline: Great Salt Lake nears total loss as toxic dust spreads across northern Utah
topics.snippet: Toxic dust is blowing across northern Utah at alarming rates as the Great Salt Lake has all but dried up, even as residents cut water use and utilities charge premiums for heavy consumption. About 62%…
topics.text:
great salt lake nears total loss as toxic dust spreads across northern utah
toxic dust is blowing across northern utah at alarming rates as the great salt lake has all but dried up, even as residents cut water use and utilities charge premiums for heavy consumption. about 62% of the water that would otherwise reach the lake is diverted for human use, 71% of that goes to agriculture, and 81% of the agricultural share grows hay and alfalfa, crops that account for less than 1% of utah's gdp; experts estimate a third to a half of that output is shipped overseas, mainly to china. governor spencer cox, an alfalfa farm owner, recently appointed farmer hannah freese as the new great salt lake commissioner, tasked with coordinating rescue, conservation and policy plans; two years ago she was selling "make alfalfa great again" hats on facebook.

topics.headline: AI companies are buying and shredding rare books to train models
topics.snippet: Reporting from Futurism and 404 Media describes AI companies bulk-buying antique and rare books, scanning them on high-speed machines that cut off the spines, and then shredding the originals. A feder…
topics.text:
ai companies are buying and shredding rare books to train models
reporting from futurism and 404 media describes ai companies bulk-buying antique and rare books, scanning them on high-speed machines that cut off the spines, and then shredding the originals. a federal judge has ruled the practice constitutes fair use on the grounds that destroying the original leaves only one copy in existence at a time. no one in the pipeline verifies whether a given volume is the last surviving copy, and local histories and self-published war memoirs are among the records being destroyed.

topics.headline: Canadian tourism boycott costs the U.S. more than $3 billion
topics.snippet: A new report from the Canadian government shows the United States has lost more than $3 billion in revenue as Canadians boycott travel south of the border. Visits fell 30% year over year in July, the…
topics.text:
canadian tourism boycott costs the u.s. more than $3 billion
a new report from the canadian government shows the united states has lost more than $3 billion in revenue as canadians boycott travel south of the border. visits fell 30% year over year in july, the sharpest such decline since the september 11 attacks. contributing factors cited include tariffs on canada and trump's remarks about canadians over wildfire smoke.

topics.headline: U.S. drone production falls far short of Ukraine's output
topics.snippet: U.S. drone manufacturing remains well below Ukraine's as the Pentagon presses for a domestic supply chain. Projected Ukrainian output runs at roughly 500,000 drones per month, while cumulative Pentago…
topics.text:
u.s. drone production falls far short of ukraine's output
u.s. drone manufacturing remains well below ukraine's as the pentagon presses for a domestic supply chain. projected ukrainian output runs at roughly 500,000 drones per month, while cumulative pentagon program orders stood at fewer than 200,000 as of february.

topics.headline: Kremlin monitors Wildberries after Ukrainian drone strikes on warehouses
topics.snippet: Russia is monitoring the retailer Wildberries following Ukrainian drone attacks on its facilities, though no decision on state aid has been made. Eight warehouses have been struck and more than 10% of…
topics.text:
kremlin monitors wildberries after ukrainian drone strikes on warehouses
russia is monitoring the retailer wildberries following ukrainian drone attacks on its facilities, though no decision on state aid has been made. eight warehouses have been struck and more than 10% of the company's storage capacity has been affected since july 18.

topics.headline: Trump administration moves to block new Chinese robots and inverters
topics.snippet: Officials say new Chinese robot and inverter models are targeted for planned U.S. import bans. The measures are framed as a technology security step.
topics.text:
trump administration moves to block new chinese robots and inverters
officials say new chinese robot and inverter models are targeted for planned u.s. import bans. the measures are framed as a technology security step.

topics.headline: Marijuana use surpasses alcohol and cigarettes in daily U.S. consumption
topics.snippet: The federal National Survey on Drug Use and Health, released this week, found that about 21.4 million Americans aged 12 and older report using marijuana daily or near-daily, defined as more than 20 ti…
topics.text:
marijuana use surpasses alcohol and cigarettes in daily u.s. consumption
the federal national survey on drug use and health, released this week, found that about 21.4 million americans aged 12 and older report using marijuana daily or near-daily, defined as more than 20 times in a 30-day period. by comparison, 17.2 million report daily or near-daily alcohol use and 19.9 million report that level of cigarette use. it is the first time marijuana has ranked above both alcohol and tobacco on that measure.

topics.headline: Former Navy SEAL sentenced for plot to bomb San Diego No Kings protest
topics.snippet: Gregory Vandenberg, 49, a former Navy SEAL, has been convicted and sentenced to 16 months in federal prison for plotting to attack a No Kings protest in San Diego with explosives.
topics.text:
former navy seal sentenced for plot to bomb san diego no kings protest
gregory vandenberg, 49, a former navy seal, has been convicted and sentenced to 16 months in federal prison for plotting to attack a no kings protest in san diego with explosives.

topics.snippet: Prosecutors say the suspect in the Berlin Pride attack recorded a pledge of allegiance to Islamic State. The recording forms part of the case being built against them.

prosecutors link berlin pride attack suspect to islamic state

topics.text:
tusk calls for an end to xenophobic attacks on ukrainians in poland
polish prime minister donald tusk urged an end to xenophobic attacks against ukrainians following recent incidents and a rise in reported hate crimes.

topics.headline: Massie says Israeli lobby spent $30 million against his campaign
topics.snippet: Representative Thomas Massie said on X that the Israeli lobby spent $30 million to defeat him but that a generation is now aware of what he called its corrosive influence on the U.S. government. He ad…
topics.text:
massie says israeli lobby spent $30 million against his campaign
representative thomas massie said on x that the israeli lobby spent $30 million to defeat him but that a generation is now aware of what he called its corrosive influence on the u.s. government. he added that every other elected republican in congress is to some degree bought, captured or intimidated, and that he is the last who is not.

topics.headline: Bipartisan House bill would direct Rubio to coordinate with allies on North Korea
topics.snippet: House Resolution 9963, introduced July 27, would authorize the Secretary of State to coordinate and engage with U.S. allies and partners to detect, attribute and disrupt certain North Korean activitie…
topics.text:
bipartisan house bill would direct rubio to coordinate with allies on north korea
house resolution 9963, introduced july 27, would authorize the secretary of state to coordinate and engage with u.s. allies and partners to detect, attribute and disrupt certain north korean activities. it is sponsored by representative young kim of california's 40th district and co-sponsored by democrat ami bera of california's 6th district. the measure has been referred to the foreign affairs committee and must clear hearings and markup before any floor vote; this congress enacts an estimated 1% to 3% of introduced bills.

topics.headline: Hiker walks 10 miles off Montana's highest peak impaled on his trekking pole
topics.snippet: David Sephalde, a 32-year-old emergency room nurse, slipped on a rock near the summit of Montana's tallest mountain and impaled himself on his own trekking pole, leaving eight inches protruding from e…
topics.text:
hiker walks 10 miles off montana's highest peak impaled on his trekking pole
david sephalde, a 32-year-old emergency room nurse, slipped on a rock near the summit of montana's tallest mountain and impaled himself on his own trekking pole, leaving eight inches protruding from each side of his body. rather than call a helicopter evacuation that would have cost thousands of dollars, he walked 10 miles back to the trailhead over six and a half hours before the pole was removed. his account, highlighted by the new york times, has drawn attention as an illustration of u.s. health care costs, and he says he plans to return next year to finish the summit.
